basic_info.description: Victorian Elegance Meets Modern Living in the Heart of the Inner Mission. Welcome to 3092 Cesar Chavez a light-filled Victorian that seamlessly blends timeless detail with modern design at the vibrant crossroads of the Inner Mission & Bernal Heights.  From the moment you enter, classic architectural touches like coved high ceilings set a warm, inviting tone. The main level offers a gracious flow: a formal living room, an elegant dining room for hosting, & a renovated chef's kitchen featuring newly installed quartz countertops & backsplash, all-new stainless steel appliances, sleek finishes, & direct access to the private patio perfect for indoor/outdoor living. Upstairs, the spacious layout includes a serene primary bedroom, one additional bedroom, & a well appointed renovated bathroom. The patios are made for gatherings, lounging, or working from home alfresco ideal for rest, creativity, or flexible living, while the two-car tandem garage offers generous storage with expansion potential. Just one block away from Precita , Garfield Square Park, near 24th Street & Cortland Avenue corridors, local markets, BART, Caltrain, & freeway access, this home offers character, comfort, & a location that connects you to the best of city life.
